matches.notes: XI identical in UEFA line-up PDF, UEFA report and FotMob. Goal 116' (El Kaabi) in UEFA, FotMob and Wikipedia. Venue named Agia Sophia Stadium (Wikipedia) / OPAP Arena (FotMob), same ground. Quini (91') from UEFA only.

XI identical in Eurosport, Foot Direct, Protothema (transliterated) and Maxifoot. Guilherme 5' (Foot Direct, Protothema, Maxifoot; Eurosport 6') and El Arabi 21' (same three; Eurosport 22'). Cafu's goal minute disputed (90+1 vs 90+3) so left null. Scorers agree across five sources.

XI identical in Eurosport and Sky Sport DE. Saviola 33'/58' per Eurosport, Sky and UEFA (Bangkok Post says 59'). Dominguez penalty in stoppage time (90+5) so minute left null. Kljestan (Anderlecht) 39'.
XI identical in Eurosport and Sky Sport DE. Scorers agree in all three; Cavani minute left null (19' vs 20'). Venue: Karaiskakis (Eurosport), Piraeus (UEFA).
XI, scorer and minute identical in Eurosport and Sky Sport DE. Venue given by one source only (Eurosport: Karaiskakis) so omitted.
XI and Mitroglou hat-trick (17', 56', 72') identical in Eurosport and Sky Sport DE. Venue by one source only so omitted.
XI identical in LaLiga and Voetbalkrant; Eurosport lists the same ten plus one blank slot; Sky Sports and UEFA mention Abidal. Scorers and minutes agree across LaLiga, Voetbalkrant, Eurosport.

XI identical in Sky Sport DE, Watson and Sports Mole. Date 16 Sep 2015 in Sky, Sports Mole and FC Bayern (Watson page shows 15.09, treated as an outlier). Muller's second goal was a stoppage-time penalty (90+2) so minute left null.
XI identical in TNT/Eurosport, SoccerLaduma and Maxifoot. Goalless draw per TNT and Maxifoot.
XI, scorers and substitutes identical in TNT/Eurosport and Maxifoot; goal minutes differ by one minute between the two (e.g. Bouchalakis 10' vs 9') so minutes left null.

matches.notes: XI identical in TNT/Eurosport and Maxifoot; minutes differ by 1-2 so left null. Venue named New Balance Arena (TNT) / Gewiss Stadium (Maxifoot), same ground.

XI identical in TNT/Eurosport and Maxifoot. Palacios and Soares scored per all three; minutes differ by 1 so left null. Panathinaikos' second scorer is disputed (Schenkeveld in Maxifoot and Betfred, Kourbelis in TNT) so omitted.
XI identical in Eurosport Italia and Maxifoot. Fortounis scored in all three; minute disputed (21' in Maxifoot and Betfred, 23' in Eurosport) so left null.
XI identical in Eurosport France and Maxifoot. Scorers agree; minutes differ by 1 so left null.
XI identical in Eurosport Germany and Maxifoot. Scorers agree; minutes differ by 1 in each case so left null.
XI identical in Eurosport Germany and Maxifoot. Mollo penalty 90' in both; Guerrero minute differs (37' vs 35') so left null.
XI, score, venue and substitutes identical in FotMob and Maxifoot.

kits.notes: Red and white stripes, white sleeves, red three stripes (both sources). Anniversary badge in both.
Red and white stripes with three white stripes on front (both sources).
Predominantly white, four red stripes on front, white sleeves and back, red collar and cuffs (both sources). Gold accents on Adidas marks are not listed as a main colour.
Red with relatively thin white stripes on the front, solid red sleeves and back (both sources).
Five red stripes on a white base, white sleeves, red shoulder stripes (both sources).
Red and white stripes (Football Kit Archive and Football Fashion).
Traditional red and white stripes, red sleeves with white cuffs (both sources).
Red and white stripes, v-collar, red sleeves, mostly white back (both sources).
Traditional red and white stripes, wider than the previous season, centenary logo (both sources).
Navy shirt with red pinstripes on the front (both sources).
Orange shirt in both sources; accent colour disputed (purple per Footy Headlines, navy per Football Kit Archive) so only the base colour is recorded.
Grey and white (both sources); Football Kit Archive calls it a graphic design on the Tiro 19 template, recorded as solid base.
Blue shirt with subtle pattern and white logos (both sources).
Blue torso with navy raglan sleeves and navy spiral graphic (both sources); orange accents noted but not a main colour.

rivals.notes: Both sources name the fixture the Derby of the Eternal Enemies and describe a class/regional rivalry (Panathinaikos central Athens, Olympiacos port of Piraeus).
